teaser: Life path 11 fills a room before a word gets said. ISFP would rather let color and gesture do the speaking. A painting half-finished waits quietly in the corner. A stranger across a room turns toward you without quite knowing why. In you, the two habits don't translate perfectly: one wants to be seen and understood by many, the other wants to be felt by one person at a time, through what gets made rather than explained. The pairing isn't a contradiction so much as a constant low negotiation between the two.
